def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if db:
        return [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using a local database from'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' {0}'.format(db)},
        ]
    
    if account:
        return [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using your'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' {0}'.format(account)},
            {'style': False, 'value': ' account'},
        ]
    
    if key:
        return [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using your'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' API Key'},
        ]
    
    return [
        {'style': False, 'value': 'Using open-source vulnerability database'},
    ]
